description: Composite TEM figure of the 15Al alloy aged at 600 °C for 6 h, combining bright-field (BF)/dark-field (DF) imaging, three selected-area electron diffraction (SAED) patterns and EDS elemental maps. (a) Left column (red dashed box): a low-magnification BF image and the corresponding DF image, both with 1 µm scale bars, showing near-equiaxed grains with dark, elongated lens-shaped particles decorating the grain/phase boundaries. (b) A central BF image (200 nm scale bar) containing two dark lens-shaped particles; coloured circles (orange, cyan, green) mark the areas whose SAED patterns are arranged around it. The top-right pattern, labelled [012] beam with a 2 nm⁻¹ scale bar, is indexed in green with β-Mn reflections (021̄, 1̄21, 1̄00, 100, 021 etc.); the lower-left [011] beam pattern (2 nm⁻¹) is annotated "FCC twin" and carries two diamond-outlined, twin-related spot sets (orange and blue); the lower-right [011] beam pattern (2 nm⁻¹) is indexed 1̄11, 200, 11̄1 for the "Cu-rich phase" (blue diamond). (c) Green dashed box: a BF image plus Fe (red), Mn (green), Al (teal) and Cu (magenta) EDS maps, each with a 1 µm scale bar; the Cu map shows bright elongated particles exactly where the Fe and Mn maps are dark. Together the panels show that fine FCC Cu-rich particles with FCC twins form at the β-Mn interfaces.

subfigures.description: Low-magnification BF TEM image (1 µm scale bar) of the 15Al alloy aged at 600 °C for 6 h, showing near-equiaxed grains outlined by dark boundaries with dark, elongated lens-shaped particles at the grain/phase boundaries.
Corresponding DF TEM image (1 µm scale bar): the same field with the boundary particles appearing bright/white against a darker matrix, plus a few large bright particles in the lower-right area.
BF TEM image (200 nm scale bar) containing two dark lens-shaped particles; orange, cyan and green circles mark the areas from which the three SAED patterns were taken.
SAED pattern labelled '[012] beam' with a 2 nm⁻¹ scale bar; a green hexagon connects spots labelled β-Mn (including 021̄, 1̄21, 1̄00 100, 021, 12̄1̄).
SAED pattern labelled '[011] beam' (2 nm⁻¹ scale bar) annotated 'FCC twin', with two diamond-shaped outlines in orange and blue marking twin-related reflection sets.
SAED pattern labelled '[011] beam' (2 nm⁻¹ scale bar) with a blue diamond indexed 1̄11, 200 and 11̄1 and labelled 'Cu-rich phase' (FCC).

Green dashed group: a BF TEM image (1 µm scale bar) and four EDS elemental maps, Fe (red), Mn (green), Al (teal) and Cu (magenta), each with a 1 µm scale bar; the elongated particles are bright in the Cu map and dark in the Fe and Mn maps, while Al is nearly uniform.

observations.observation: Panel (a) contains two TEM images with 1 µm scale bars: a low-magnification BF image (left) and its corresponding DF image (right), in which the boundary particles appear bright.
Panel (b) centre is a BF TEM image with a 200 nm scale bar showing two dark lens-shaped particles marked with orange, cyan and green circles indicating where SAED patterns were recorded.
The top-right SAED pattern is labelled '[012] beam' (2 nm⁻¹ scale bar) and its spots are indexed in green as β-Mn, including 021̄, 1̄21, 1̄00, 100, 021 and 1̄2̄1̄.
The lower-left SAED pattern is labelled '[011] beam' (2 nm⁻¹ scale bar) and is annotated 'FCC twin', with two diamond outlines (orange, blue) marking twin-related reflections.
The lower-right SAED pattern is labelled '[011] beam' (2 nm⁻¹ scale bar) and is indexed 1̄11, 200, 11̄1 under the label 'Cu-rich phase', i.e. an FCC structure.

Panel (c) pairs a BF image with four EDS maps labelled Fe (red), Mn (green), Al (teal) and Cu (magenta), each carrying a 1 µm scale bar; the elongated interface particles are bright in the Cu map and dark in the Fe and Mn maps.
Free-text labels 'FCC twin', 'Cu-rich phase', 'β-Mn', '[011] beam' and '[012] beam' are printed directly on the diffraction panels.

The caption states the figure shows TEM images of the 15Al alloy aged at 600 °C for 6 h: (a) low-magnification BF and corresponding DF image, (b) SAED patterns from the circled coloured areas, (c) BF image and corresponding EDS elemental mapping.

The citing text states that after aging at 600 °C for 6 h the α matrix completely disappeared and abundant near-equiaxed β-Mn formed, with fine particles evenly distributed at the interfaces between the β-Mn.
The citing text states that the SAED patterns in Fig. 11(b) indicate that the fine particles have an FCC crystalline structure, with FCC twins frequently observed within the particles.
The citing text states that Fig. 11(c) shows the FCC phase is rich in Cu, depleted in Fe and Mn and slightly poor in Al, and that the β-Mn is poor in Cu.
The citing text introduces the term 'FCC Cu-rich phase' for these precipitates on the basis of the Fig. 11(c) compositional evidence.
